response.sql: SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS average_uric_acid, AVG(l.HCT) AS average_hematocrit FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = p.ID AND r.RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID ORDER BY AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL, AVG(l.HCT) DESC, p.ID LIMIT 10
